info.name: HomeKeys Liberty - API
info.description: Canonical API collection with a single login flow. Set loginEmail, loginPassword, newUserPassword, targetUserId and propertyAgentId with local values before running. Role-dependent assertions adapt to the authenticated user. The ADMIN never sets passwords: Create user queues a single-use invitation and the user defines their own password through the link. Emails are queued through the durable outbox, so emailSent means the email was queued. Captaciones covers property CRUD, ownership, status, reassignment and the pre-signed photo flow. Run these requests only against a local development database.
